pulls.title: Add Sonatype Guide workflow for automated dependency updates
pulls.author: sonatype-guide
pulls.body:
## What does this PR do?

This PR adds the Sonatype Guide GitHub Actions workflow to enable automated dependency updates and security fixes.

### Features
- Manual trigger via GitHub Actions UI
- Security mode for fixing specific vulnerabilities
- Automated PR creation with recommended updates

Learn more: https://links.sonatype.com/products/guide/docs/agent-p
